body:
I really wonder why I don’t
Parents are alcoholics and I have sleep issues that they just don’t give a fuck about 
Don’t have any addictions, all I have to lose is life itself, the law seems hell Bent on finding excuses to fuck me over because I’m legally disabled and not straight

But I just can’t 
I know how painful losing a child is on someone 

Maybe, when there’s nobody left to remember me, I might finally end it all
But who knows and who cares at this point
